data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Steven total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_greek.name: Στέφανος

in_latin.name: Steven
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Steven est nomen Christianum quod significat Crown, garland. Hoc nomen in cultura Christiana est valde significativum.
